stage: Exploratory causal follow-up after the registered one-step mechanism screen
trigger: One-step information gains survived selected high-order integration checks, but common-G conditional gains can differ in sign from ideal Bayes gains. User requested experiments and regional-observability relevance.
candidate_model: Same favorable finite bank with known ordinary waveform and onsets 7/8. Each world maintains its own bank. True hypothesis is used for attack generation and scoring only.
fixed_policy: Use development_fixed_v already frozen in results/summary.json; do not refit on closed-loop paths
sampler: Same original radial variables and base uniform angle quantiles across all policies; invert actual policy CDF on [0,pi). No post-observation choice of current watermark.
quadrature: Same coarse grid 8 radial x 32 angles x 11^2 Gaussian nodes; this causal run is a numerical feasibility diagnostic, not a new high-accuracy certificate
healthy_comparison: Actually run each policy's own healthy world; never reuse an attacked-world correction or policy for the healthy counterfactual
resource_scope: Same radial/spectral law and conditional expected coding energy; realized energy differs. Assumes ideal synchronized authenticated policy feedback; feedback cost and cryptographic security are not validated.
limits: adaptive only at first three candidate times
does not test all-onset robustness or long-run safety
